summary:
To acquire responsible position in progressive organization where I can utilize my skill and creatively involved
with system that effectively contributes to growth of organization.
Professional Summary:
• Highly motivated Senior IT professional with 10 years of experience Spanning Software quality assurance, User
Acceptance Testing, UI, UX, Test Management, Test Planning, Defect Management, Change Management,
Release Management, Business, requirement Analysis, Project Management with a wide variety of projects of
Banking(Cash Management System, Bulk payments, Payments - NEFT, RTGS, UPI, Net Banking, Finnaxia-
Receivables, Collections, Liquidity Management, Mandates), Capital Markets (Stock, F&O, Mutual Funds),
Automotive and Manufacturing Domain(Oracle Siebel CRM) and environments with Overseas and Indian clients.
• Extensive experience in Functional Testing of Client Server, web Applications, CRM and iOS,Android Mobile
Applications.
• Managed Software Testing teams of 8 to 10 resources.(developing Test Plan, Communicating with stakeholders
on requirement analysis in shift-left walkthrough, sharing test estimations, assigning task, training the new team
member, analyzing the test result, ensuring quality, sharing the daily, weekly status reports to clients, sharing
monthly timesheets of team to pmo with clients approval)
• Expertise in gathering, analyzing Software Requirement Specification, Understanding the SRS documents and
identifying the required Test Scenarios for Projects.
• Knowledge on different levels of Testing (Unit Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing and Acceptance Testing)
& well versed with Agile, waterfall, Methodologies
• Extensive Experience in Black Box Testing which includes Functional Testing, Regression Testing, Smoke Testing,
Sanity testing, System Testing, GUI Testing, Integration Testing, User Acceptance Testing.
• Involved in preparing Test Case Design and executing the scripts.
• Defect Reporting and Tracking using Tools like Jira, Zephyr, Backlog, SBI UAT Tracking, Bugzilla, BMC Remedy,
Mantis, Tarantula.

• Involved in participation of regular weekly project status meetings to discuss the risks involved in ongoing projects
with Client, Teammates and Team Lead.
• Creation of RTM, Heat Map, Closure Report
• Extensive experience in SDLC Lifecycle, STLC Lifecycle.
• A highly organized and goal-oriented individual with effective communication and interpersonal skills, Skilled
leader/team player, have the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
